```python
import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.sensor as sens
import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1.  Configure Chrono data paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
veh.SetDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + "vehicle/")
print("Vehicle assets path:", chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + "vehicle/")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.  Initial vehicle configuration
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
initLoc = chrono.ChVector3d(0, -5, 0.4)
initRot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

# Visualization types
chassis_vis_type    = veh.VisualizationType_MESH
suspension_vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES
steering_vis_type   = veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES
wheel_vis_type      = veh.VisualizationType_NONE
tire_vis_type       = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

# Simulation parameters
step_size        = 1e-3
tire_step_size   = step_size
render_fps       = 50
render_step_size = 1.0 / render_fps

# Sensor parameters
noise_model   = "NONE"
update_rate   = 10      # Hz
image_width   = 1280
image_height  = 720
fov           = 1.408   # horizontal field of view
lag           = 0.0
exposure_time = 0.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.  Create and initialize the Gator vehicle
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
gator = veh.Gator()
gator.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC)
gator.SetChassisFixed(False)
gator.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
gator.SetBrakeType(veh.BrakeType_SHAFTS)
gator.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType_TMEASY)
gator.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)
gator.SetInitFwdVel(0.0)
gator.Initialize()

gator.SetChassisVisualizationType(chassis_vis_type)
gator.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(suspension_vis_type)
gator.SetSteeringVisualizationType(steering_vis_type)
gator.SetWheelVisualizationType(wheel_vis_type)
gator.SetTireVisualizationType(tire_vis_type)

print("Vehicle mass:   ", gator.GetVehicle().GetMass())
print("Driveline type: ", gator.GetVehicle().GetDriveline().GetTemplateName())
print("Brake type:     ", gator.GetVehicle().GetBrake(1, veh.LEFT).GetTemplateName())
print("Tire type:      ", gator.GetVehicle().GetTire(1, veh.LEFT).GetTemplateName())
print()

# Use the Bullet collision engine
gator.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4.  Create a flat rigid terrain
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(gator.GetSystem())
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, chrono.CSYSNORM, 50, 50)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 1.0))
patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 50, 50)
terrain.Initialize()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.  Add a box and a cylinder to the world
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Box
box = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(1, 1, 1, 1000, True)
box.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.5))
box.GetVisualModel().GetShape(0).SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/blue.png"))
gator.GetSystem().AddBody(box)

# Cylinder  (note: signature is radius, height, density)
cyl = chrono.ChBodyEasyCylinder(0.5, 1.0, 1000, True)
cyl.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 1.5))
cyl.GetVisualModel().GetShape(0).SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/blue.png"))
gator.GetSystem().AddBody(cyl)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.  Interactive driver (no GUI in this example)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
driver = veh.ChDriver(gator.GetVehicle())
driver.Initialize()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7.  Sensor manager & lighting
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
manager = sens.ChSensorManager(gator.GetSystem())
intensity = 1.0
manager.scene.AddPointLight(chrono.ChVector3f(2, 2.5, 100),
                            chrono.ChColor(intensity, intensity, intensity),
                            500.0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8a.  Third‐person RGB camera
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
rgb_offset = chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVector3d(-8.0, 0.0, 1.45),
                             chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(0.2, chrono.ChVector3d(0,1,0)))
cam = sens.ChCameraSensor(
    gator.GetChassisBody(),
    update_rate,
    rgb_offset,
    image_width, image_height,
    fov
)
cam.SetName("Third Person RGB")
cam.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterVisualize(image_width, image_height, "Gator Camera"))
manager.AddSensor(cam)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8b.  LIDAR sensor
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
lidar_offset = chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVector3d(0.0, 0.0, 2.0),
                               chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(0.0, chrono.ChVector3d(0,1,0)))
lidar = sens.ChLidarSensor(
    gator.GetChassisBody(),
    update_rate,
    lidar_offset,
    800,      # horiz samples
    300,      # vert channels
    2*chrono.CH_PI, chrono.CH_PI/12, -chrono.CH_PI/6,
    100.0,    # max range
    sens.LidarBeamShape_RECTANGULAR,
    2,        # sample radius
    0.003,    # divergence horiz
    0.003,    # divergence vert
    sens.LidarReturnMode_STRONGEST_RETURN
)
lidar.SetName("Lidar Sensor")
lidar.SetLag(lag)
lidar.SetCollectionWindow(1.0/update_rate)
lidar.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterDIAccess())
lidar.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterPCfromDepth())
lidar.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterXYZIAccess())
lidar.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterVisualizePointCloud(640, 480, 1.0, "Lidar Point Cloud"))
manager.AddSensor(lidar)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8c.  --- NEW --- Depth camera
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
depth_offset = chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVector3d(-5.0, 0.0, 2.0),
                               chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(0.0, chrono.ChVector3d(0,1,0)))
depth_cam = sens.ChDepthCameraSensor(
    gator.GetChassisBody(),
    update_rate,
    depth_offset,
    image_width, image_height,
    fov,
    30.0                # maximum depth = 30 m
)
depth_cam.SetName("Depth Camera")
depth_cam.SetLag(lag)
depth_cam.SetCollectionWindow(1.0/update_rate)
# visualize depth map
depth_cam.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterVisualizeDepth(image_width, image_height, "Depth Map"))
manager.AddSensor(depth_cam)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.  Main simulation loop
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
time = 0.0
end_time = 30.0

print("\nStarting simulation loop...")
print("  time[s]   x[m]    y[m]    z[m]    yaw[rad]")

while time < end_time:
    time = gator.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # simple steering & throttle
    driver.SetSteering(0.5)
    driver.SetThrottle(0.2)
    inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # synchronize modules
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    gator.Synchronize(time, inputs, terrain)
    manager.Update()

    # log vehicle pos & heading
    pos = gator.GetVehicle().GetChassisBody().GetPos()
    rot = gator.GetVehicle().GetChassisBody().GetRot()
    # compute yaw from quaternion (z‐axis heading)
    w, x, y, z = rot.e0, rot.e1, rot.e2, rot.e3
    yaw = math.atan2(2*(w*z + x*y), 1 - 2*(y*y + z*z))
    print(f"{time:8.3f}   {pos.x:7.3f} {pos.y:7.3f} {pos.z:7.3f}   {yaw:7.3f}")

    # advance all
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    gator.Advance(step_size)

    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

print("Done.")
```

Explanation of the main fixes and additions:

 1. **Cylinder** construction was using the wrong argument order.  `ChBodyEasyCylinder` takes `(radius, height, density, collide)`.  
 2. The non‐existent `ChFramed` class was replaced by the correct `ChFrameD` (double‐precision frame) for both RGB and LIDAR sensors (and our new depth camera).  
 3. A **depth camera** (`ChDepthCameraSensor`) was created at `(-5,0,2)`, with FOV = 1.408, resolution 1280×720, max depth = 30 m, and a depth‐map visualization filter (`ChFilterVisualizeDepth`).  
 4. At each time step we query the chassis’s position and orientation, compute a yaw angle from its quaternion, and print `time, x, y, z, yaw`.  

This script should run end‐to‐end given a valid PyChrono/Vehicle/Sensor installation.

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.vehicle.gator as gator
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.sensor as sens

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Initialize Chrono system
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
chrono.SetChronoDataPath('./')   # set this to your Chrono data folder if needed
system = chrono.ChSystemSMC()
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -9.81))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Create the Gator vehicle
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
veh.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())
my_gator = gator.Gator()
my_gator.SetContactMethod(veh.ChContactMethod_SMC)
my_gator.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0,0,0.2), chrono.QUNIT))
my_gator.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType_PAC89)
my_gator.SetDrivelineType(veh.DrivelineType_SPKV)
my_gator.SetBrakeType(veh.BrakeType_SHAFTS)
my_gator.Initialize()

# Set visualization types for various subsystems
my_gator.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
my_gator.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
my_gator.SetSteeringVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
my_gator.SetWheelVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
my_gator.SetTireVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create a rigid terrain
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(system)
patch = terrain.AddPatch(chrono.CSYSNORM,                # plane at z=0
                         chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0),
                         200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 20, 20)
terrain.Initialize()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create the Irrlicht visualization & interactive driver
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
app = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(my_gator.GetVehicle(), system, 'Gator Demo', chronoirr.dimension2du(1280, 720))
app.AddTypicalLogo()
app.AddTypicalSky()
app.AddTypicalLights()
app.AddTypicalCamera(chronoirr.vector3df(0.0, -6.0, 1.7), chronoirr.vector3df(0, 0, 0.5))
app.AssetBindAll()
app.AssetUpdateAll()

driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver(app)
driver.Initialize()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create the sensor manager and attach lights + camera to the chassis
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
sens.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + 'sensor/')

sensor_manager = sens.ChSensorManager(system)

# 5a) Two point lights (one above & in front, one to the side)
pose_light1 = chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(1.0, 0.0, 1.5), chrono.QUNIT)
light1 = sens.ChPointLightSensor(parent = my_gator.GetChassisBody(),
                                 updateRate = 30,
                                 offsetPose = pose_light1,
                                 dims = sens.ChVector2<int>(1,1))   # dummy dims
light1.SetLightProperties(color = sens.ChColor(1,1,1), intensity = 3000)
sensor_manager.AddSensor(light1)

pose_light2 = chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(0.0, 1.0, 1.2), chrono.QUNIT)
light2 = sens.ChPointLightSensor(parent = my_gator.GetChassisBody(),
                                 updateRate = 30,
                                 offsetPose = pose_light2,
                                 dims = sens.ChVector2<int>(1,1))
light2.SetLightProperties(color = sens.ChColor(1,1,0.8), intensity = 1500)
sensor_manager.AddSensor(light2)

# 5b) A color camera facing forward from the chassis
cam_pose = chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(0.6, 0, 1.2), 
                           chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(chrono.CH_C_PI/2, chrono.ChVectorD(0,1,0)))
camera = sens.ChCameraSensor(parent       = my_gator.GetChassisBody(),
                             updateRate   = 30,
                             offsetPose   = cam_pose,
                             imageWidth   = 640,
                             imageHeight  = 480,
                             fov_y        = 1.0472)  # 60 degrees
camera.SetName("FrontCam")
camera.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterVisualize(640, 480))   # pop up an OpenGL window
sensor_manager.AddSensor(camera)

# Final initialization of sensors
sensor_manager.InitializeAll()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Simulation loop
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
timestep = 1.0/60
while app.GetDevice().run():
    # Irrlicht draw call
    app.BeginScene()
    app.DrawAll()

    # 1) Driver inputs
    driver.Synchronize(my_gator.GetChassis()->GetPos(), my_gator.GetVehicleSpeed(), 0)

    # 2) Terrain does not need explicit sync
    #    but for consistency:
    terrain.Synchronize(0,0,0)

    # 3) Vehicle modules
    my_gator.Synchronize(driver.GetInputs(), 
                         terrain.GetNormal(), 
                         terrain.GetContactForces())
    my_gator.Advance(timestep)

    # 4) Sensors
    sensor_manager.UpdateAll()

    app.EndScene()

    # advance time in mechanics
    system.DoStepDynamics(timestep)
```

Explanation of key steps:
1. We create a `ChSystemSMC` and set gravity.
2. We instantiate the Gator from the `vehicle.gator` module, choosing SMC contacts, PAC89 tires, etc., and set different visualization modes (mesh/primitives).
3. We add a large rigid terrain patch (200×200 m) textured with a tile image.
4. An Irrlicht application (`ChIrrApp`) drives both rendering and an `ChIrrGuiDriver` for interactive steering/throttle/brake.
5. A `ChSensorManager` owns two `ChPointLightSensor`s (to illuminate the scene) and one `ChCameraSensor`.  We attach them to the chassis with specified poses.  The camera pushes a `ChFilterVisualize` so you see the live camera view.
6. In each frame we:
   - Render with Irrlicht.
   - Synchronize driver, terrain, and vehicle modules.
   - Advance the vehicle and system by `timestep`.
   - Update all sensors so lights and camera render.
   - Proceed to the next Irrlicht frame.

This skeleton should compile and run as long as your Chrono data folder (with meshes, textures, sensor shader code) is correctly specified. Feel free to add further sensors or tune lighting, camera parameters, or driver logic as needed.

```python
import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.sensor as sens
import math

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Utility: simplify names for colors and frames
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def BlueColorAsset():
    c = chrono.ChColorAsset()
    c.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0, 0, 1))
    return c

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Create the vehicle and set up its initial properties
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
veh.SetDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + 'vehicle/')

# Initial vehicle location and orientation
initLoc = chrono.ChVectorD(0, -5, 0.4)                       # moved to y = -5
initRot = chrono.ChQuaternionD(1, 0, 0, 0)

# Visualization types for the vehicle
chassis_vis_type    = veh.VisualizationType_MESH
suspension_vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES
steering_vis_type   = veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES
wheel_vis_type      = veh.VisualizationType_NONE
tire_vis_type       = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

# Time steps and end time
step_size      = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size
render_step    = 1.0/50
end_time       = 30

# Driver inputs
steer_input   = 0.5
throttle_input= 0.2

# Create and initialize the Gator
gator = veh.Gator()
gator.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC)
gator.SetChassisFixed(False)
gator.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysD(initLoc, initRot))
gator.SetBrakeType(veh.BrakeType_SHAFTS)
gator.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType_TMEASY)
gator.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)
gator.SetInitFwdVel(0.0)
gator.Initialize()

gator.SetChassisVisualizationType(chassis_vis_type)
gator.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(suspension_vis_type)
gator.SetSteeringVisualizationType(steering_vis_type)
gator.SetWheelVisualizationType(wheel_vis_type)
gator.SetTireVisualizationType(tire_vis_type)

print("Vehicle mass:   ", gator.GetVehicle().GetMass())
print("Driveline type: ", gator.GetVehicle().GetDriveline().GetTemplateName())
print("Brake type:     ", gator.GetVehicle().GetBrake(1, veh.LEFT).GetTemplateName())
print("Tire type:      ", gator.GetVehicle().GetTire(1, veh.LEFT).GetTemplateName())
print("")

gator.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Create a rigid ground patch (terrain)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(gator.GetSystem())
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, chrono.CSYSNORM, 50, 50)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 1.0))
patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 50, 50)
terrain.Initialize()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Add two fixed obstacles: a blue box and a blue cylinder
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Note: we use the "easy" bodies which come with collision and visualization
box = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(1.0, 1.0, 1.0,     # x,y,z sizes
                           1000,             # density
                           True, True)       # collide? visualize?
box.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.5))      # center at z=0.5
box.SetBodyFixed(True)
box.AddAsset(BlueColorAsset())
gator.GetSystem().Add(box)

cyl = chrono.ChBodyEasyCylinder(0.5, 1.0,    # radius, height
                                1000,        # density
                                True, True)
cyl.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1.5))      # center at z=1.5
cyl.SetBodyFixed(True)
cyl.AddAsset(BlueColorAsset())
gator.GetSystem().Add(cyl)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Create the interactive driver
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
driver = veh.ChDriver(gator.GetVehicle())
driver.Initialize()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Create the sensor manager, camera and LIDAR
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
manager = sens.ChSensorManager(gator.GetSystem())

# a little ambient light for the scene
manager.scene.AddPointLight(chrono.ChVector3f(2, 2.5, 100),
                            chrono.ChColor(1,1,1),
                            500.0)

# -- third-person camera --
cam_offset = chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(-8.0, 0.0, 1.45),
                             chrono.ChQuaternionD(1,0,0,0))
camera = sens.ChCameraSensor(
    parent=gator.GetChassisBody(),
    updateRate=10.0,
    offsetPose=cam_offset,
    width=1280,
    height=720,
    fov=1.408
)
camera.SetName("ThirdPersonCam")
camera.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterVisualize(1280,720,"Gator Camera"))
manager.AddSensor(camera)

# -- LIDAR sensor --
lidar_offset = chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVector3D(0.0, 0.0, 2.0),
                               chrono.ChQuaternionD(1,0,0,0))
lidar = sens.ChLidarSensor(
    parent=gator.GetChassisBody(),
    updateRate=10.0,
    offsetPose=lidar_offset,
    horizontalSamples=800,
    verticalSamples=300,
    horizontalFOV=2 * chrono.CH_C_PI,
    verticalFOVUp=   chrono.CH_C_PI/12,
    verticalFOVDown=-chrono.CH_C_PI/6,
    maxRange=100.0
)
# set beam shape, radius, divergence, return mode
lidar.SetBeamShape(sens.ChLidarSensor.BeamShape_RECTANGULAR)
lidar.SetLaserScanRadius(2.0)
lidar.SetBeamDivergenceAngle(0.003)
lidar.SetReturnMode(sens.ChLidarSensor.ReturnMode_STRONGEST)
# push filters for Depth, Intensity, XYZI and a basic visualize
lidar.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterLidarDepth())
lidar.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterLidarIntensity())
lidar.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterLidarXYZI())
lidar.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterVisualize(800, 300, "Lidar Scan"))
manager.AddSensor(lidar)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Simulation loop
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
time = 0.0

while time < end_time:
    time = gator.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # driver inputs
    driver.SetSteering(steer_input)
    driver.SetThrottle(throttle_input)

    # collect and synchronize
    inputs = driver.GetInputs()
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    gator.Synchronize(time, inputs, terrain)
    manager.Update()

    # advance each module
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    gator.Advance(step_size)

    # keep real time
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
```
